about.title: Metal Recovery Experts
about.introTitle: We buy and value industrial metal materials.
about.introBody: Greenway International connects material knowledge, final purchasing capacity, 4PL service, and market studies to recover metals with technical value: tungsten, wolfram, tungsten carbide, specialty alloys, stainless steels, and non-ferrous metals.
about.operatingTitle: Every lot is handled with identification, pricing, and traceability.
about.operatingBody: We do not treat scrap as generic volume. We review origin, likely composition, physical form, cleanliness, mixing, location, 4PL logistics, and market context to structure a serious offer and an executable operation.

operatingItems.title: Material identification
operatingItems.body: We review photos, piece type, process origin, mixing, and alloy signals to guide valuation.

operatingItems.title: Buying and valuation
operatingItems.body: We structure offers for metals with demand and use market studies when a lot requires price, timing, and opportunity validation.

operatingItems.title: 4PL and traceability
operatingItems.body: We integrate 4PL service for pickup, documentation, warehouses, consolidation, and international movement when the lot requires it.

about.experienceTitle: Presence designed to recover metals across markets.
about.proofBody: We have documented operations, visits, and opportunities in the United States, Colombia, Chile, Spain, and Italy, always around recoverable materials and final industrial purchasing.
about.closingTitle: Send us your material and we will review the best recovery path.
about.footerBufferTitle: Tungsten, tungsten carbide, specialty alloys, and industrial metals.
about.footerBufferBody: We prioritize materials with technical value: wear tools, inserts, drill bits, turnings, sludge, industrial parts, stainless steels, nickel, cobalt, titanium, and non-ferrous metals.

work.heroTitle: How we buy and recover industrial metal lots.
work.heroBody: Greenway reviews the material, validates technical value, structures a purchase offer, and coordinates the operation when the lot requires 4PL logistics or market reading.
work.routeTitle: From lot evidence to a purchase ready to execute.
work.routeBody: The priority is to decide quickly and correctly: what the material is, how much recoverable value it carries, where it is, how it is presented, and which operating path lets Greenway buy clearly.

routeSteps.title: We receive lot evidence
routeSteps.body: We request general and close-up photos, approximate weight, city, part type, and industrial process context.

routeSteps.title: We read the material
routeSteps.body: We classify the lot by metal family and detect signs of tungsten, tungsten carbide, stainless steel, nickel, cobalt, or other alloys.

routeSteps.title: We define the purchase offer
routeSteps.body: Greenway structures an offer based on probable composition, condition, cleanliness, volume, separation, and real material demand.

routeSteps.title: We activate 4PL when needed
routeSteps.body: When the operation requires it, we coordinate pickup, warehouse, documentation, consolidation, and domestic or international movement.

routeSteps.title: We close buying and recovery
routeSteps.body: We align final conditions, payment, material receiving, and operating records for future recurring purchases.

work.modelTitle: The purchase is decided by material, market, and operation.
work.modelBody: We do not quote generic volume. We review the recoverable value of the metal, the market moment, and the logistics route required to make the operation viable.

products.heroTitle: Buying and recovery of industrial metals.
products.heroBody: Greenway works with materials of high technical value: tungsten, tungsten carbide, stainless steels, nickel, cobalt, titanium, non-ferrous metals, and metal-bearing process residues.
products.materialTitle: The right material deserves technical evaluation.
products.materialBody: A lot can be worth much more when it is properly identified. We review physical form, origin, cleanliness, mixing, weight, and likely composition to guide purchase and recovery.

materialItems.title: Stainless and non-ferrous
